pipeline.title: BioNTech pays $205M for FDA voucher to speed up ‘late-stage oncology pipeline’
pipeline.summary: BioNTech has agreed to pay $205 million to purchase an FDA priority review voucher to support a future filing of a drug in its “late-stage oncology pipeline.” Fierce breaks down which candidate is most likely to claim the regulatory accelerator.

pipeline.title: Amgen builds Sjögren’s case with detailed phase 3 data ahead of Novartis showdown
pipeline.summary: Amgen has shared more data from a phase 3 Sjögren’s disease trial that dazzled analysts, digging into the details that could shape its showdown with Novartis.

pipeline.title: Abbott nabs FDA approval, CE Mark for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator lead
pipeline.summary: Abbott has received both FDA and CE Mark approval for its UltiSynq defibrillation lead tech, which is designed to deliver both conduction system pacing and defibrillation therapy.

pipeline.title: Merck KGaA lands FDA nod in rare tumor disorder, portending Ono, Daiichi showdown
pipeline.summary: The FDA’s decision was based on Merck’s phase 3 Maneuver trial and follows similar approvals by other global regulators, including in China, Canada and Switzerland.

pipeline.title: Beam’s sickle cell therapy results tee up potential Casgevy, Lyfgenia showdown
pipeline.summary: Gearing up for a potential FDA filing by the end of the year, Beam Therapeutics revealed results from a phase 1/2 study of its base-edited cell therapy risto-cel, showing the potential sickle cell treatment reduced the most painful complications of the blood disease for a full ye

pipeline.title: ImmunityBio juggles phase 3 win and 20% stock crash en route to Anktiva front-line expansion
pipeline.summary: ImmunityBio's Anktiva secured a pivotal phase 3 win in front-line non-muscle invasive bladder cancer, but lack of detailed data and disappointing third-quarter financials sent the biotech's stock tumbling by 20%.

pipeline.title: Start Center for Cancer Research opens first early-phase clinical trial site in Italy
pipeline.summary: Start Center for Cancer Research has expanded into Italy, partnering with Istituti Fisioterapici Ospitalieri to open its first early-phase cancer clinical trial site in the country.

pipeline.title: PepGen’s stock doubles as midphase muscle dystrophy data wow analysts
pipeline.summary: PepGen’s phase 2 myotonic dystrophy type 1 data have met analysts’ best-case scenario, causing the biotech’s share price to more than double.

pipeline.title: J&J readies Caplyta for FDA label expansion after 2nd phase 3 win in bipolar mania
pipeline.summary: J&J is gearing up to expand the commercial reach of Caplyta after scoring a second phase 3 victory in bipolar mania.

pipeline.title: Mirum scores again in hepatitis D phase 3, setting the stage for brelovitug’s FDA run
pipeline.summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals has kept its clinical winning streak alive in hepatitis D, meeting the primary endpoint in another late-stage trial of its antiviral monoclonal antibody brelovitug.

pipeline.title: Novocure denied FDA approval for Optune Mya cancer device after efficacy concerns

pipeline.summary: Swiss data engine Rivia has launched a new AI-powered data review module to speed up clinical data cleaning.

pipeline.title: J&J-backed Delix drums up $100M series C for non-hallucinatory psychedelic for depression

pipeline.summary: Lilly's oral GLP-1 Foundayo significantly reduced sleep apnea severity in a phase 3 study presented at the AHA Scientific Sessions on Monday. Now, the pharma is approaching the FDA in hopes of a label expansion.

pipeline.title: Recent Lisata prize Marea touts ‘exciting’ lipid disorder phase 2 win, mulls obesity potential

pipeline.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim is gearing up to take survodutide to regulators next year after the obesity drug proved its cardiovascular credentials in its latest phase 3 study.

pipeline.title: FDA cites record request breakdowns in trio of warning letters to API makers

pipeline.title: Phillips Medisize strikes deal to expand UK inhalation production
pipeline.summary: Phillips Medisize, a Molex subsidiary CDMO that focuses on inhalation products and other medical and diagnostic products, is growing its manufacturing footprint in the U.K.

pipeline.summary: The San Diego-based biotech has shown that when its vaccine-like therapeutic, N17350, is injected directly into the tumor, the candidate is even able to clear cancer lesions that are distant from the injected tumor.

pipeline.summary: Shortly after locking down a world-first approval in China, Bayer is bringing its groundbreaking stroke prevention drug stateside, with an FDA green light that honors the German drugmaker’s cardiovascular heritage and signals the sort of first-in-class opportunities it’s increasi

pipeline.title: Asking More of Science: How Daiichi Sankyo Is Challenging Assumptions About the Future of Cancer Care
pipeline.summary: See how Daiichi Sankyo is asking more of science to bring the next wave of innovation to patients.

pipeline.title: Fierce Biotech Layoff Tracker 2026: Vertex trims 78 employees; Coherus lays off 30% of workforce
pipeline.summary: As always, if you know of layoffs occurring at a biotech, please reach out to the Fierce Biotech editorial team.
